title: 5-Minute Prep French Onion Baked Chicken
cookTime: about 40-45 minutes (30 min covered + 10-15 min uncovered)
ingredients: 4 chicken breasts, sliced into thinner cutlets or pounded to an even thickness
1 (10.5 oz) can condensed French onion soup
instructions: If chicken breasts are thick, slice them in half horizontally to create thinner cutlets or pound them to an even thickness.
Pour the French onion soup into the bottom of a baking dish. Season chicken with salt, pepper, and garlic powder and arrange over the soup.
Spread the French onion dip over the chicken. Top with crushed croutons, then add the provolone slices.
Cover with foil and bake for about 30 minutes. Remove the foil and bake another 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and golden and the chicken reaches 165°F internally.
notes: Creator: Whitney Kai Lyn (asa palette cafe). Full recipe was included directly in the reel caption. Caption tagline: '5 minutes of prep + one baking dish = the easiest weeknight dinner!'
